    Examples

    Example: DotExample

    ![../_images/DotExample-1.png](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/_images/DotExample-1.png)

    ```
    from manim import *

    class DotExample(Scene):
        def construct(self):
            dot1 = Dot(point=LEFT, radius=0.08)
            dot2 = Dot(point=ORIGIN)
            dot3 = Dot(point=RIGHT)
            self.add(dot1,dot2,dot3)
    ```
